primary_bottleneck: Model Capability Failure (Synthetic Pretraining Template Overfitting & Attention Failure)
causal_explanation: COLLISION-10M was pre-trained on synthetic template-based data. During inference, the model ignores prompt context tokens and generates memorized template completions (e.g. '(Revision)\nAnswer: ...'). Retrieval, tokenization, context delivery, and evaluator components operate correctly, but the model lacks the attention/generative capacity to condition its output on retrieved evidence.
